publisher: The Diary Of A CEO（Steven Bartlett）
label: 影片 20（下）
theme: Druski：關係、投資自己與一步一步的階梯
themeEn: Druski: They're Lying To You About Overnight Success! (Part 3)

ex.en: There's the obsession, there's the dedication, there's the hours.
ex.zh: 有執著、有投入、有投入的時數。

fam: dedicated adj. 專注的；專用的

tips.t: thank you for your dedication 感謝你的付出（表揚公告）；a dedicated team 專注的團隊。

ex.en: So I feel like a lot of my upbringing was around this broad horizon of different different ethnicities, different genders of everybody.
ex.zh: 所以我覺得我的成長環境很多元，有各種不同族裔、不同性別的人。

tips.t: broaden your horizons 開拓眼界；on the horizon 即將到來。

ex.en: Did you have to mature or learn a skill of like coming from where you come from to be in a a room with these big brands and these people in suits in corporate America?
ex.zh: 從你的出身，到走進有大品牌、穿西裝的美國企業人士的會議室，你需要變得成熟，或學習某種技能嗎？

tips.t: corporate headquarters 公司總部；corporate event 企業活動。

ex.en: How what what is your decision framework there with like because there's this term you know I worked in advertising for a long time.
ex.zh: 你的判斷框架是什麼？因為有一個詞，你知道，我在廣告業工作了很久。

tips.t: decision framework 決策框架；within the framework of 在～的架構下。

ex.en: You can never show me something that I've done that was like, "Oh, that's punching down or that wasn't inclusive of the other person that might have been in that situation." or oh,
ex.zh: 你永遠找不到我做過什麼是：「喔，那是在欺負弱勢」，或「那沒有顧及當時在那種情境裡的另一個人」，或是：喔，

tips.t: an inclusive workplace 友善包容的職場；all-inclusive 全包式（旅遊方案）。

ex.en: They sent it to my management and I think they accidentally sent the proposal.
ex.zh: 他們寄給我的經紀團隊，我想他們不小心寄錯了提案。

tips.t: submit a proposal 提交企劃；a budget proposal 預算提案。

ex.en: I was reading that you were rejected by both Netflix and Amazon. Yeah. Early on.
ex.zh: 我讀到你被 Netflix 和 Amazon 都拒絕過。對。在早期。

tips.t: reject an offer／application 拒絕提議／申請（反義 accept、approve）。

ex.en: And I decided to just go and all these show ideas that I had, I'm going to do it on YouTube and spend my own money to invest into it.
ex.zh: 我決定把我所有的節目點子都拿去 YouTube 做，花我自己的錢投資在上面。

tips.t: invest in new equipment 投資新設備（注意接 in）。

ex.en: If you don't see the vision yourself, you're almost doing yourself a disservice.
ex.zh: 如果你自己都看不見那個願景，你幾乎是在虧待自己。

tips.t: do someone a disservice 對某人不利、虧待某人。

ex.en: Most people will go and grab the money because the money's good and they'll they will dilute the whole brand and wash it away before it was ever even able to start.
ex.zh: 大多數人會去拿錢，因為錢很好賺，然後在品牌還沒開始之前，就把整個品牌稀釋、沖淡掉了。

tips.t: dilute the brand 稀釋品牌價值；dilute with water 用水稀釋（產品說明）。

ex.en: And that's I was like, okay, a good balance is a healthy lifestyle.
ex.zh: 然後我就想，好，健康的生活方式就是一種好的平衡。

tips.t: work-life balance 工作與生活平衡；account balance 帳戶餘額（銀行題）。

ex.en: You see the superstar Druski and what he has evolved to become.
ex.zh: 你看到的是超級巨星 Druski，以及他已經蛻變成的樣子。

tips.t: the company has evolved into 公司已發展成～。

ex.en: So, it's like that's the type of evolving I'm looking to do in my career where I can continue to just keep transcending and and I didn't learn to talk that way.
ex.zh: 所以這就是我在職業生涯中想要的那種蛻變，能夠持續超越自己，而且我不是學會這樣說話的。

tips.t: transcend boundaries 超越界限（比 surpass 更抽象）。

ex.en: But it's interesting because I think it's everything's nuanced and when you've got a passion, of course, you pursue it and when especially when there's evidence. Yeah.
ex.zh: 但這很有意思，因為我覺得一切都有細微的差別，當你有熱情，當然你要去追求，尤其是有證據的時候。對。

tips.t: a nuanced view 細膩的觀點；not black and white＝不是非黑即白。

ex.en: turbulent childhood you had and the odds were very much stacked against you for num numbers of reasons, for you to pass your way through that and climb to the very top
ex.zh: 你經歷過的動盪童年，基於種種原因，一切都對你非常不利，而你能一路走過來，爬到你這個產業的

tips.t: turbulent market 動盪的市場；experience turbulence 遇到亂流（機上廣播）。

comp.q: Druski 認為在娛樂產業往上爬，最關鍵的是什麼？
comp.a: 人際關係：你怎麼待人、別人信不信任你
opts: 人際關係：你怎麼待人、別人信不信任你

comp.q: 他做喜劇的原則是什麼？
comp.a: 不拿弱勢開刀，笑點出自善意
opts: 不拿弱勢開刀，笑點出自善意

comp.q: 被 Netflix、Amazon 拒絕之後，他怎麼做？
comp.a: 自己花錢在 YouTube 做節目，投資自己
opts: 自己花錢在 YouTube 做節目，投資自己

comp.q: 面對遙遠的大目標，他的建議是什麼？
comp.a: 專注在一步一步的小步驟
opts: 專注在一步一步的小步驟

comp.q: 如果能對大學宿舍裡的自己說話，他會說什麼？
comp.a: 更相信自己，路難走時也要堅持、別半路跳車
opts: 更相信自己，路難走時也要堅持、別半路跳車
